steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I never thought the cave would be so close to a volcano.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: My tail is feeling so warm—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Meowch! It's hot!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's on fire!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Now I get why you want to close the mine. We'd have done the same, in your shoes.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This place has definitely been overmined. It even has an Originium processing plant, but none of the specialized equipment you'd usually see...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This has gone way further than a tiny village can handle.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Mining so carelessly without strict safeguards in place will only result in the leakage of active Originium particles, and inevitably cause Catastrophes.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But what I don't get is...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Based on what you said, they started mining seven years ago, and the person who lead the project was your uncle, the current village headman.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So... why do the tunnels stretch so deep after just seven years? They can't possibly have dug all this themselves.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You're half-correct.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The mining tunnels weren't dug by the villagers, they were already here before.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Remember what I said earlier, about the beast outbreak seven years ago?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, you said it was a real serious one, and that old Kashiwau's son, Akira, was also a hunter... and lost his life in it.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That was a direct consequence of the mining.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You good, Scholar?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I'm purrfectly fine, what exactly did I trip on?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Bones?!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, that's a whole lotta bones, plus teeth, and... claws?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: They have been dead fur a long time...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Wait, this form... It must have been a large carnivorous creature! This is my furst time seeing one here!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Judging from its remains, it would have been covered in scales and have well-developed forelimbs with long and sharp claws. So it most pawbably was good at digging holes!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: An arma-clawbeast.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That's their name. A type of predator that once inhabited this region. They were social creatures that would dig their nests in the mountains.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: This mine was actually one of their nests, and they built majestic palaces over the years while tunneling through the surrounding Originium veins.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But we haven't seen a single one down here, or in the forest.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That's because... they disappeared seven years ago.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Disappeared?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Disappeared? Fur real?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The very last trace of their species in this area is the pile of skeletons before you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: How... How exactly did something like that happen?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Back when this Originium mine was newly discovered, Akira Kashiwau was firmly against the project.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: He reckoned destroying the arma-clawbeasts' nests would net unpredictable consequences, and that Originium mining itself wasn't exactly safe either.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: On the other hand, my uncle and the other villagers believed that they desperately needed the potential profits to change their grueling way of life.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: So concealing it from Akira, they and the other hunters banded together to exterminate all the arma-clawbeasts in the region. In order to freely mine the Originium.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: But the slaughter resulted in the surviving arma-clawbeasts rampaging through the forest, leading to the beast outbreak that year.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So many innocent lives were lost... just for the sake of opening a mine.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You must have seen my uncle's attitude, yes?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: To him, the Rathalos is simply the manifestation of vengeance from all the beasts he's slaughtered. He definitely has dreams about Akira's death on the regular too.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: His closest friend, his apprentice, carried out the will of a hunter to the very end... and died for his sake.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: And now that Akira's predictions have come true... naturally he's terrified.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Akira died for the headman's sake? I thought he lost his life protecting the village...?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The outbreak wasn't threatening the village, but was closer to the mine.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: He was beset by frenzied beasts whose numbers far surpassed any regular outbreak we'd seen.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Oh, we're here.
Originium rocks were clustering around the lava bubbling in the cave.
The King of the Skies lifted its head.
The insignificant Oni looked down.
Their eyes each reflected the other's gaze.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Chikushou-me.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It's surrounded by a bunch of Originium rocks.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Since you didn't want to deal with it right now, take care not to get too close.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: If we accidentally anger it, we'll be in deep trouble.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Got it. Scholar... where you at?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The Rathalos... seems to be using the Originium fur its lair.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: This is impawssible to comprehend...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It looks like... it's in a lot of pain. Is it because of the Originium on it?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Most pawbably, and there seems to be substantially more particles compurred to our previous encounter.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Right now it's more or less an oversized source of pollution spreading Originium dust wherever it goes.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: My hypawthesis is that... the Rathalos most pawbably was just trying to survive, and ended up nesting here.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But being deep in the mines, it's constantly exposed to Originium.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: When it returns to the forest to feed, the flames it spews while hunting will in turn trigger the clusters on its body, dispersing purrticles everywhere.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So it's a victim of Originium too.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Must you hunt it, Noir Corne?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The Originium is too much of a danger to leave alone, and considering the safety of both the village and ourselves, hunting it is the best way of handling the situation.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But if we can deal with just the clusters... I just need a little more time! I'll bring out my binoculars...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What else could there be...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow? Those tracks are...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Scholar, come quick! You're too far out, the ground's too unstable over there!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Haha... caught ya.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow.. I was so afuraid!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne! Why didn't mew warn me earlier?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Did mew see that?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The bignawculars just bounced off the Rathalos's head.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Sparks are coming out of its jaws.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Just run already! The mine is gonna be destroyed!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Run fur it!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm running!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: If it triggers all the Originium here, the anomalies are definitely going to spike, and then...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It'll be a Catastrophe!

a.text: A black mist shrouds the sky, and the mountains and rivers burst.
Wind scales the peaks, and flames rise like a crimson tide.
Vegetation burns to ashes, and life into coal.
The village gates swing open, and the houses collapse.
All life cowers, and the heavens fall.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Nghh... hah... hah...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They're dodging my slashes so easily.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: How foolish. You clearly lack a hunter's intuition. Their weak point is the soft patch of skin in their jaws.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stab straight in, so you can slit the throat.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Got it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Sixfold Slash!)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A hit! Ah...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Have a taste of this, kono yarou!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Aghh—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We did it!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Be careful of the rear, mew two!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Nanja korya?!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Twofold Slash!)

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Are my hands... losing their strength?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: On my way to a certain village, I heard tales of an endless stream of dragons, but to... purrsonally witness a similar event.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The beast outbreak is showing no signs of abating. If we remain trapped here, we'll eventually collapse from exhaustion. We have to find a way out.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If we can make our way to those tall trees over there, we can make use of the canopy's height to avoid the rampage.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I have an idea.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This is the powder I used to trigger the hornbeasts earlier, in hopes of luring out the Rathalos. But I used too much and lost control of the herd.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Using it on people is unheard of, and probably suicidal. But right now.... this might be our only method of drawing them away.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But that means...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, whoever is affected by it will be beset by the entire horde... But as long as we can make our way through, it will be worth it... Probably...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No... Artisan, do you still have that rope from earlier?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Yes! I made so meowch of it!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Good... it's long and tough enough to support the weight of multiple people. If we tie it to the tree, we can use it as a makeshift grappling hook to retrieve whoever's acting as bait.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Which will be me, so if you would...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No, I must be the bait.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I won't allow it. It's too dangerous to let you get surrounded by the horde again. If you sacrifice yourself here, wouldn't that make my efforts to save you meaningless?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I don't know if I'd be able to rescue you with these old hands of mine, but I can at least make sure not to croak before you rescue me.

spans.text: I don't know if I'd be able to rescue you with these old hands of mine, but I can at least make sure not to croak before you rescue

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I have faith in you, girl.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Fine, let's do this.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Come, you dastards! Over here!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, just like that! Chase me like the lunatics you are!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now's my chance!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Flurry Rush!)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hrrh—haah!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: It worked... purrfectly!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Deploy the grappling hook immediately, I'll go retrieve Kashiwau!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: These beasts just charge straight at me with wild abandon.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: We really lured them away...I can't believe it.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: There's simply so many of them...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That day... that day seven years ago, was also like this...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Brat... Is this how you felt, that night? Did you... die to something like this?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Was this... what you saw in your final moments?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Surrounded by these beasts, encircled by their jaws, drowning in their saliva.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You must have been slaying them one after another with this spear, just like this.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: But no matter how many you killed, there were always more of these damnable beasts, wave after relentless wave.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ngh—Agh! Begone!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Kuso! They saw you as a mere slab of meat to be divided between themselves, no longer among the living.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And knowing you, brat, you probably just kept your mouth shut, rather than calling for help.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Simply brandishing this lance till your strength failed you, till you could wield it no longer.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Collapsing on some rocks, slowly falling to your knees... Yet the beasts never ceased their advance!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ah... so that's how it was.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau, grab my hand!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you blanking out for?! Quickly!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Got you!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Palico, pull the rope!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Finally...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Not yet, your meowjesty... The branches over there have broken...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Meowny more beasts rush over as we speak!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Chikushou, is there anything else we can do?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty, look! The beasts are scattering all of a sudden!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mrow... A noise from the sky.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Rathalos soars through the sky! And that's...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Nantekotta...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A Catastrophe...
The gale carelessly bound both land and sky together with flame, like an ignorant life devouring everything in its path.
Trees were but weeds within the tornado of fire, and mountains crumbled to rubble.
The most fearless of warriors were powerless to stand against it, and the most devout prayers echoed to no avail.
It had arrived, the land's retribution.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Jump down! Brace for impact!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is everyone alright?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I'm... purrfectly fine as well.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The sky is alight... Pillars of crimson flame... Kuso, what a truly terrifying sight.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I've read about a similar case on the landship before.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A hurricane unleashed by a Catastrophe encircled a mountain on fire, becoming a ferocious firestorm.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: As it moves, the vortex pulls from its surroundings. And with everything combustible in this forest... I can't imagine the consequences.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Why...  Why did the Catastrophe strike so soon?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The center of the firestorm... it's near the mine.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The mine?!
Taste my blade!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey! So this is where you guys were. See, Scholar? Just like I said...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That's enough yapping, Noir Corne. I expect a full report soon.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Aight.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: ...Old Kashiwau? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I could ask you the same thing, Mirai.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You can hardly call this fortunate, but at least we managed to escape the horde thanks to the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't know what the situation in the village is right now, but the core of the Catastrophe is still quite a ways away and moving fairly slowly. However, that's not the case with the beast outbreak.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Any ideas on how to return to the village as soon as possible?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Ah, if that's still nearby... Maybe we can use it to descend the mountain quickly!

spans.text: still nearby... Maybe we can use it to descend the mountain quickly!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It has not been used for a long time. I can't be sure if it still works.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So, uh, planning on letting the rest of us in on this?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: There's a railcar. We used it a lot when the mines were just opening, and it made things real convenient, but after the cave was repaired we more or less abandoned it.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Don't worry, it should still work fine. It was the very first thing I designed, after all.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Weren't you an ecologist? I'm not sure I should trust your skills as a railcar engineer...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau, our next battle won't be any easier, so I hope you're prepared.

steps.name: Takii Kashiwau
steps.text: I don't suppose you'd let this old man loaf about for once?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Please, by all means. I fully intend to respect your opinion.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm aware that I tend to ignore the ideas of those around me and insist on doing things my way. And that this is a behavior I should correct.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The mistakes I've made were precisely because of that, and I should also apologize for what I said earlier.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm sorry for my unproductive words, without knowing anything about your background. I did not intend to hurt you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So will you accept my apology?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Fine... if it pleases you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Good, then that's settled.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Girl...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Earlier you said you understood me... what did you mean by that?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ah, that... It's a bit of a long story.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: If it's a bother, just pretend I didn't ask.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, I don't mind. You see, before joining Rhodes Island, I was an assassin.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Nani?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A literal killer, acting on orders to take the lives of my people, day and night.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Until one day, I looked at my bloodstained hands and felt nothing but fear in my heart. The next day, I was tasked to dispose of a mother and daughter, but chose to protect them instead.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Because I didn't want to be a killer anymore. That was also the day I met Noir Corne, who listened to my story and chose the same path.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But I'd made a mistake. It wasn't just a matter of refusing to kill.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The pair I saved were so frightened of me that I could only leave them in a safe place. And while in the moment I felt only the weightless relief of not taking a life, I had forgotten something important...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That the only end awaiting them was to be killed by someone else.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Do you... regret it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes. For a long time after that, I... often dreamt of them. They would ask me why I had left them to die.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I didn't want to hurt innocents anymore, but I still ended up indirectly cutting their lives short.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I used to wonder if I was even capable of protecting anyone at all.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Luckily, I had help... Thanks to him, I made my decision.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You mean the boy over there?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He scolded me—a rare occurrence—and said...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: 'The past is the past... All your remorse, all the sins you carry, make up for them with your future.'

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I took him for just an oddball, but I suppose he's got a proper head on after all.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What he said seemed right to me, and since then I haven't given it much thought.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We decided to make it our mission to protect others, and he dragged me along to join Rhodes Island. And because of our similar objectives, we're still working together even now.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This must be some company, to hiring on people like you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So protecting others is your way of atoning for your past?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You might say it started like that, but I've had a few additional insights along the way.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I've seen too much life and death. There are many reasons people might surrender their lives, and some even seek death out of ignorance.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You could say I stubbornly impose my will on others, but only because of my duty to protect your lives.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Life in this land is not meant to end so easily, but to be lived and experience all its possibilities.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So I will continue my efforts.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't want to regret anything, or to see people forced to gaze only at ruins.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So I refuse to leave you alone.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato! Kashiwau! We found the railcar and it's still working!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, what're you both looking at me like that for? Is there something on my mask?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's nothing. We'll be right over.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Anyway, I look forward to cooperating with you in the upcoming battle, Kashiwau.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Holds out hand)

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I've told you this so many times already, that's my quarry.

spans.text: I've told you this so many times already, that's

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You need only watch from the sidelines and applaud my brilliance.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The path you've chosen is not an easy one.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: All I can do is wish you the best.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Likewise.
